document_metadata.document_title: Harris County Low Impact Development & Green Infrastructure Design Criteria for Storm Water Management

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Projects exceeding one acre require a Storm Water Quality (SWQ) Permit and SWQMP; treat the first 1 inch of runoff. LID IMPs may satisfy quality and detention credits per Harris County criteria. Conventional gravity detention minimum rate 0.55 ac-ft per acre.
peak_flow_calculation_method: Detention and hydrograph matching per HCPID-AED / HCFCD requirements
Minimum detention 0.55 ac-ft/acre for gravity systems
